scope: Offline correction and validation of the diagnosed GFW port/voyage segmentation mechanisms, followed by rebuilding affected downstream results in new private runs. Existing annual products, incoming files, review forms and accepted analysis remain unchanged.

rules.nominal_entry: Nearest reviewed catalog cell within 3 km.
rules.stop_supported_entry: An observed calculated-speed stop below 0.2 kn within the existing 4 km outer region may open an annulus-entry visit. Mark this separately; it is a GFW grid-supported stop, not proof of commercial berth use.
rules.city_support: An open visit uses the union of nearby cells in its corrected frozen analytical city; another city cannot donate a stop or AIS gap. Keep the opening cell if the nearest cell belongs to another city, and mark a stop with conflicting nearest-city support as ambiguous.
rules.stop_region: Stop transitions apply throughout the open 4 km city-supported visit.
rules.gap_evidence: Only a gap between consecutive AIS samples, with both samples in the same open city-supported visit, counts. Returning after continuously observed movement is not an AIS gap.
rules.exit_reentry: After closing a visit, re-evaluate the same AIS sample for entry into the next visit.
rules.boundary_uncertainty: Store bracketing AIS times. Entry/exit brackets of at least 4 h are unresolved boundaries, not exact arrival/departure times.
rules.short_stop_uncertainty: A closed low-confidence visit with at least two in-region observations and a quantization-consistent possible stop is unresolved. Use the full 0.01-degree-cell diagonal as a conservative location allowance because reported coordinates are not assumed to be cell centres. Do not manufacture a confirmed stop.
rules.candidate_guard: Quarantine candidates with unresolved origin departure or destination arrival, ambiguous endpoint city, or unresolved intermediate visits in a different city. Retain the reason and full pre-guard denominator.
rules.source_motion_guard: Quarantine voyages containing an adjacent observed point pair requiring more than the existing 36 kn fast cap even with +1 h timing allowance; do not guess which point is bad.
